title: Massive GTA VI leak reveals fully playable version and causes stock market drop for Take-Two
summary: A hacker leaked a complete, playable build of GTA VI, causing billions in market value losses for Take-Two.

title: Rust supply chain attack injects malware into packages with 245 million downloads
summary: Researchers discover malicious code in popular Rust crates that executes during compilation, affecting millions of projects.

title: China successfully tests engine of its 'space taxi' and recovers ZhuQue-3 rocket, advancing toward reusable orbital flights
summary: Chinese space program achieves key reusability milestones with a 5,211-second engine test and successful landing of ZhuQue-3 rocket.

title: Programmer manages to run DOOM on a 2010 Canon EOS 550D DSLR camera
summary: A modder adapts the classic game to run on the limited hardware of a 16-year-old DSLR, demonstrating the engine's extreme portability.

title: Modders convert Wii Remotes into functional Joy-Con 2 controllers for Nintendo Switch 2
summary: An enthusiast integrates new Joy-Con electronics into Wii Remote shells, creating hybrid controllers with magnetic motion detection.

title: Framework-recommended BIOS update bricks Laptop 13 motherboards with Ryzen 7040
summary: An official firmware update blocks device booting, with repair costs ranging from $20 to over $500.

title: Unboxing and setup videos of Valve's 'Steam Frame' VR glasses leak before official announcement
summary: Steam client for ARM accidentally exposes promotional material for Valve's new VR headset, confirming its existence.

title: Meta launches native Meta AI app for macOS, expanding its assistant beyond the browser
summary: The company deploys a dedicated Mac app allowing access to its language model without relying on the web interface.

title: Linux 7.2 release reaches distributions like Garuda Linux with scheduling improvements and hardware support
summary: The new kernel version includes a scheduler that improves performance on modest hardware and comes preinstalled in Garuda's 'Temeraire' edition.
